verdict.rationale: Shortcut's own docs list native GitHub and Slack integrations, along with Figma, GitLab and Bitbucket. GitHub has some feature depth, such as overlapping-PR detection. Google Drive, one of the three tools the story names, is never mentioned, and the Slack integration is only a one-line listing. Missing for 10: native Google Drive integration evidence, documentation of Slack integration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Seamless integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and other tools mean Shortcut updates while you work.
Avoid merge conflicts and duplicative code when using the GitHub integration
